title: Headmaster bans Louis Braille's books at the first school for the blind

tellings.quote: a new Headmaster came into school he was like this is pseudo science this isn't real he locked away all the braille books

plain: At the first school for the blind in France, a new headmaster is said to have called the raised-dot reading system invented by Louis Braille pseudoscience and locked away all the braille books. Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about children said to read minds, tells this from the history of Louis Braille without naming a source. She gives it as an example of a real ability being dismissed as unreal by the people in charge.
